contracts.Inspect: Read-only; no RF compute request, active transmitter change, cluster mutation, or result invalidation.
contracts.Map Focus: Visualization emphasis and map viewport only; no RF compute request or Scenario identity change.
contracts.Scope: Filters existing rays; no RF compute request or Scenario identity change.
contracts.Signal: May lazily request the existing coverage-surface endpoint after explicit user action; it does not call analyze-sector, simulate, optimize-network, interference, or change plan inputs.
contracts.Rays: Visibility only; no additional RF compute request.
contracts.Metric: Selects an existing SINR/RSRP/RSRQ result presentation; no new computation.
contracts.LayersAndMenus: Visibility/disclosure state only; no RF compute request.
contracts.SelectCells: Changes Network cluster plan membership using existing semantics; no computation until the explicit Evaluate Network action.

evidence.test: changes map presentation without launching another RF request
evidence.result: Pass; Rays, Ray scope, and Map Focus are changed after a completed run without increasing API post count.

evidence.test: enables Signal after RF completes, loads the surface lazily, and keeps ray toggles presentation-only
evidence.result: Pass; one explicit /api/coverage-surface request is allowed, while /api/analyze-sector remains at one request and Rays adds none.

evidence.test: inspects cells and opens Inventory without changing the plan
evidence.result: Pass; zero analyze-sector, simulate, optimize-network, or interference requests during inspection, Focus, and Inventory navigation.

evidence.test: Select cells changes cluster membership and Clear selected cluster reverses it
evidence.result: Pass; zero compute requests across membership change and clear.

evidence.test: keeps Map Focus and ray Scope out of Scenario identity
evidence.result: Pass; Map Focus/Scope-only edits preserve active Scenario identity; an RF-affecting ray-count edit still clears it.
